# Flatworld Solutions

> > Flatworld Solutions (FWS) is a global BPO provider offering call center services, creative design, virtual assistants, and business process outsourcing with Lean Six Sigma methodologies and AI/ML integration.

Operating delivery centers across India, Philippines, Colombia, and Bolivia, Flatworld Solutions delivers outsourced services including multilingual customer support, lead generation, graphic design, and data management. The company emphasizes quality frameworks like Lean Six Sigma, DMAIC, Voice of the Customer (VoC), and compliance standards including HIPAA, ISO, ACORD, and CAQH.

## Key Topics

- Flatworld Solutions (FWS)
- Lean Six Sigma & DMAIC methodology
- Voice of the Customer (VoC) & Critical to Quality (CTQ)
- AI/ML and artificial intelligence integration
- Lead generation & customer retention
- Multilingual call center services
- CRM integration (Salesforce, NetSuite, Dynamics)
- Outbound calling & telemarketing
- Creative services & graphic design
- BPO services & outsourcing to India
- HIPAA, ISO & ACORD compliance
- Remote video surveillance & CCTV monitoring
- Virtual assistant services
- Customer support & live chat
- Enterprise security solutions
